entry.title: MPC Overwitch Send 0.6.0
entry.summary: Open-source plugins for Akai MPC standalone. Installation: unzip, copy the plugin folder into `VST2 Plugins` on an MPC drive. Requires MPC OS 3.10.1+ and Preferences → Enhancements (Beta) → Enable Enhancements and External Plugin Support. Like the project?
